entity_set.definition: Every edge-incident CloudNode in the current device-local Kuzu graph whose layer is not semctl; semctl is excluded to prevent inference from prior C2/C3 output, and isolated nodes carry no topology signal so are outside this view's entity set.

consensus_affinity_node_annotation.semantics: Entity features retain consensus_affinity=ABSENT because no node-level scalar affinity is defined; this is not pairwise W coverage and must not be used to infer missing pair measurements.

pairwise_consensus_affinity.semantics: Every unordered entity pair is defined by the immutable factorized W carrier and evaluator in STRUCTURE.matrix; no pair rows are embedded here.

matrix.evaluator: W_STRUCTURE(i,j) = numerator(i,j) / 25 for every unordered pair {i,j} with 0 <= i < j < 19482
matrix.consumer_contract: Resolve the immutable factorized_W URI, verify its sha256, and reconstruct W through the carried evaluator and partitions; pairs remains empty because no pair rows are embedded in this view. Entity features.consensus_affinity=ABSENT denotes only the intentionally undefined node-level scalar annotation; pairwise consensus coverage is complete and separately measured in coverage.pairwise_consensus_affinity.

computation.requested: degree-corrected SBM runs followed by pair co-assignment frequency over N runs
computation.executed: 25 graph-tool degree-corrected SBM runs; the complete consensus is served through the immutable factorized artifact reference

reproducibility.seed_policy: anchor-derived; requested and effective seeds are carried per run in the immutable records artifact
reproducibility.per_run_record: The immutable records artifact carries 25 distinct seeds, 25 full 19,482-node partitions, objective, iteration count, convergence state, input digest, implementation version, and running-image digest.
reproducibility.consensus_definition: W_STRUCTURE(i,j) = runs placing i and j in the same block / 25; this consensus, not a selected partition, is the measured view.

discrimination_gate.observed: The full 189,764,421-pair domain has 26 distinct affinity values; the matrix is neither uniformly zero nor uniformly one.
discrimination_gate.rule: PASS only if N runs complete and the consensus matrix contains at least two affinity values with neither all-pair 0 nor all-pair 1.

failure_mode.distinction: The completed run records and numeric factorized consensus distinguish measured low affinity from missing evidence.

views.named_hazard_answer: The accepted digest-addressed image ran graph-tool 2.68 and emitted 25 complete, converged, independently checked partitions; no substitute community algorithm is credited.

views.signal: what changes together, with pinned Git-recency heat metadata

entity_set.definition: Distinct repository-relative paths participating in at least one repeated co-change pair (>=2 shared accepted commits). Accepted commits are non-merges at or before the anchor, after declared machine exclusions, with 1..25 retained paths.

matrix.default_for_unlisted_pair: MEASURED-ZERO (both entities were observed in the same pinned commit frame and shared no accepted commit)
matrix.affinity_definition: shared accepted commits / sqrt(accepted commits touching i * accepted commits touching j)

computation.heat: Path-resolving Git history; exp(-ln(2)*age_days/30.0). comp-heat score is not called.
computation.drift: Not used: comp-drift is a propagation-target orchestrator, not a file-pair feature at this entity grain. Explicit ABSENT is carried per entity.

reproducibility.seed_policy: NONE: deterministic Git DAG walk, sorted paths, canonical JSON
reproducibility.per_run_record: git anchor, anchor timestamp, accepted commit SHAs/paths digest, cap, exclusions, path counts, and pair shared-commit counts

discrimination_gate.rule: PASS iff acquisition is non-empty, at least two distinct positive affinities exist, and nonzero-pair density is strictly between 0 and 1.
discrimination_gate.negative_control: An all-1 constant-affinity mutant fails because it has one distinct value and density 1.

failure_mode.mode: Git retrieval failure, vacuous eligible population, cap/exclusion domination, or a constant affinity matrix.
failure_mode.distinction: Retrieval and vacuity are hard failures; ABSENT features are explicit; a genuine low-affinity pair is a MEASURED-ZERO inside a non-empty pinned frame.

views.named_hazard_answer: comp-heat score is NOT USED because it does not resolve its id. Heat metadata is derived only after the file path is resolved by the pinned Git history. comp-drift is grain-incompatible and carried ABSENT, never zero.
